decision_scope: Research output responsibility and semantic-model governance only; no default promotion and no training resumption.

roles.PROFILE_DIRECTION: A supported whole-profile direction such as fruit, floral or sweet; retained separately when the policy calls for it and never expanded into leaves.
roles.NAMED_DESCRIPTOR: A recognizable named flavor, including registered evidence-qualified middle categories and specific words.
roles.OTHER_NATIVE_MEASUREMENT: A source-native measure such as body, acidity or intensity that keeps its original meaning and is not admitted to flavor output just because it is scored.

policy_differences.OUT_MIXED: Exact R8 rank-sliced mixed main<=5 and secondary<=3; profile is not separated.
policy_differences.OUT_SPECIFIC_FIRST: Named descriptors come first across the 5+3 pool; original order is preserved within each role and profile directions fill only a real named shortage.
policy_differences.OUT_SEPARATED: Only named descriptors enter main/secondary and comparison; return short on shortage. Up to three already-supported directions appear in overall_profile outside the 5+3 budget.

old_data_proxy_result.summary: Across 77 repeatedly viewed development coffee groups, C01 OUT_MIXED main gap/recall/NDCG were 0.69178/0.26646/0.24441 and pool values were 0.54577/0.39080/0.29389. OUT_SPECIFIC_FIRST and OUT_SEPARATED had identical main and comparison content in all 79 C01 cases: main 0.64777/0.29664/0.26938 and pool 0.44773/0.48562/0.34679.
old_data_proxy_result.actual_difference_summary: For C01, all-three main content matched in 46/79 cases and all-three full comparison content matched in 7/79. OUT_SPECIFIC_FIRST and OUT_SEPARATED main/secondary matched in 79/79; their sole observed difference was overall_profile. No current case had fewer than eight eligible named descriptors, so the shortage fallback was not exercised by real R8 cases.
old_data_proxy_result.scope_limit: Not independent confirmation; no user preference or effect inference.

real_feedback.reason: No filled owner-controlled participant file was available. Synthetic ratings were not created.

rationale: Main and secondary have one clear job: offer evidence-supported named flavors.
Overall direction remains available without consuming or duplicating the specific 5+3 comparison budget.
Returning short avoids invented child descriptors when specific evidence is insufficient.
The fixed profile field supports a low-burden same-main with/without-profile formative check.
recommendation.specificity_guard: Do not state a descriptor more specifically than the existing candidate evidence supports.

unvalidated: Coffee-enthusiast preference, usefulness, burden and misleading over-specificity.
Independent semantic confirmation on frozen identifier and relation registries.

semantic_model_governance.decision: The coffee-flavor model is an evidence- and ontology-constrained semantic reasoner, not a feedback recommender. Participant preference, satisfaction, perceived fit, expression help, burden, post-output acceptance and profile preference cannot train, calibrate, weight, select, alter or validate the model or its architecture.
semantic_model_governance.authoritative_basis: Provenance-backed identifiers, explicit concept roles, registered dimension membership, explicit descriptor relations, question-answer evidence state and hard output contracts.

owner_decision.approval_rule: Only the real responsible owner may change status to OWNER_APPROVED. Approval does not resume training or promote the research adapter automatically.
owner_decision.approval_scope: Backend output-role contract only. This approval does not claim empirical superiority, change the default finalizer, authorize a frontend, or resume training.
owner_decision.approval_note: Owner approved named descriptors in main/secondary and already-supported directions in overall_profile, with no invented child descriptors.
owner_decision.approved_product_decision: Use OUT_SEPARATED as the backend output-role contract: named descriptors in main/secondary and supported directions in overall_profile.

formative_study_pack.data_limit: Participant IDs, coffees, live C01 outputs, observations and timings remain blank until real sessions occur.

post_decision_audits.mechanism: For C01, 46/79 main outputs were unchanged and 33/79 removed a profile direction and promoted a named descriptor. Among 57 evaluable coffee groups, gap improved for 15, tied for 42 and regressed for 0; 20 groups had no evaluable target. Seven records gained an exact target and none lost one. Within-role reorder count was zero.
post_decision_audits.middle_category: Evidence-qualified middle categories appeared 141 times in C01 separated main. They had zero exact fine-target hits under the unchanged R8 fine-reference contract; they remain valid product semantics but receive no automatic fine metric credit.
post_decision_audits.evidence_chain: Of 632 C01 separated descriptor occurrences, 152 were explicit user expressions, 324 shared only a supported direction, and 156 had no direct current-answer trace. There were 312 broader-or-sibling specificity review flags across 78 records; 49.37% is a review-queue rate, not an observed error rate.
post_decision_audits.profile_quality: All 198 C01 profile occurrences had K1 support and a selected-or-confirmed support trace; no profile overlapped the 5+3 pool. Nine profile occurrences lacked a named-output dimension counterpart, which is complementary coverage rather than an automatic contradiction or benefit.

future_training_target_spec.reason: Future objectives are limited to internal semantic evidence and hard constraints. Relation-aware post-selection requires owner-approved provenance edges; no 1.0/0.6/0.4 score, MMR lambda, propagation decay, submodular beta or participant-derived target was adopted.
future_training_target_spec.history_policy: V1 and V2 preserved; V3 stored at a new immutable owner-controlled path.

registered_dimension_extension.definition: Cluster means one of the nine existing support_dimension_ids; no cluster discovery, learned edge or iterative propagation was performed.
registered_dimension_extension.evidence_reception: C01 contained 370 unique selected-answer evidence items and 424 evidence-dimension links. Fifty-four evidence items reached multiple dimensions, a 14.59% multi-dimension incidence rate; eight of nine dimensions received evidence.
registered_dimension_extension.concentration_result: The proposed concentration hypothesis was not supported. OUT_SEPARATED increased mean active dimensions from 4.234 to 4.461 and normalized entropy by 0.0159 while decreasing HHI by 0.0073. It was less concentrated in 34/79 records, more concentrated in 20/79 and tied in 25/79.
registered_dimension_extension.static_vote_result: The uniform one-pass registered-dimension vote had coffee-group macro Spearman association 0.2877 with the frozen named-candidate score order. This is descriptive, tie-heavy association and does not establish learned factor propagation.
registered_dimension_extension.coverage_score_result: Fine-reference recall improved for OUT_SEPARATED from k=2 through k=8, while mean uncalibrated raw score was lower at every k. Boundary margins were not uniformly higher. No confidence, probability or Pareto policy claim was made.

concentration_hypothesis_deconstruction.evaluation_scope: C01 has 79 records across 77 repeatedly viewed development coffee groups; 59 records across 57 groups have positive frozen T and are evaluable for target-derived coverage and fit. This is not independent confirmation.
concentration_hypothesis_deconstruction.metric_roles: Coverage recall is paired with dimension precision and Jaccard; redundancy is reported through named-descriptor load and registered-dimension overlap proxies; diversity-adjusted fit uses R8 one-to-one match gain with fixed alpha sensitivity. No composite quality score was created.
concentration_hypothesis_deconstruction.main_result: OUT_SEPARATED versus OUT_MIXED increased all-role target-dimension recall by 0.0351 and named-only recall by 0.0614. All-role precision fell by 0.0149 and all-role Jaccard was nearly flat (-0.0009). Repeated-dimension membership rose by 0.0725 and mean pairwise dimension overlap rose by 0.0286. Diversity-adjusted fit at alpha=0.5 rose by 0.0253 (higher in 16/59 evaluable records, lower in 0, tied in 43).
concentration_hypothesis_deconstruction.comparison_pool_result: OUT_SEPARATED increased all-role target-dimension recall by 0.0132 and named-only recall by 0.0336, while all-role precision fell by 0.0165 and all-role Jaccard fell by 0.0104. Repeated-dimension membership rose by 0.0726 and mean pairwise overlap rose by 0.0197. Diversity-adjusted fit at alpha=0.5 rose by 0.0353 (higher in 39/59 evaluable records, lower in 0, tied in 20).
concentration_hypothesis_deconstruction.profile_result: Adding OUT_SEPARATED overall_profile to its unchanged comparison pool increased target-dimension recall by only 0.0022 while dimension precision fell by 0.0064 and Jaccard fell by 0.0049 on the old target proxy. Profile usefulness remains a separate formative user question.
concentration_hypothesis_deconstruction.interpretation: The concentration hypothesis decomposes into a tradeoff: role separation improves old-target coverage and one-to-one diversity-adjusted fit, but increases coarse registered-dimension redundancy and does not improve dimension precision/Jaccard consistently. OUT_SEPARATED remains an approved role contract, not an empirically dominant output policy.
concentration_hypothesis_deconstruction.alpha_policy: Fixed sensitivity values 0.0, 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75 were all reported. None was learned, selected or adopted as a product tradeoff weight.

internal_semantic_integrity.registry: All 82 concept IDs and nine registered dimensions passed role/dimension integrity; frozen PARENTS dimension membership matched. The current contract has zero descriptor-level relation edges.
internal_semantic_integrity.structure: All 79 C01 OUT_SEPARATED records passed identifier integrity, role purity and frozen legality; 632 named descriptors and 198 profile occurrences were checked, with zero native-measurement leakage and zero unsupported profile occurrences.
internal_semantic_integrity.evidence_trace: Of 632 C01 named output occurrences, 152 had direct descriptor traces, 324 had supported-dimension compatibility only and 156 had no current-answer semantic trace. Only 24.05% are ready for strict descriptor assertion under the direct-or-registered-relation rule.
internal_semantic_integrity.specificity: Without registered broad-to-child or sibling relation edges, 165 specific-from-broader/sibling and 147 middle-from-direction occurrences require relation review; they cannot be called confirmed violations or passes from shared dimensions alone.
internal_semantic_integrity.dimension_coverage: Named outputs represented 204/213 supported K1 dimension occurrences (95.77%); 70/79 records were complete and nine each missed one supported dimension.
internal_semantic_integrity.decision: OUT_SEPARATED is structurally sound but current frozen candidates must not be presented as strict semantic assertions unless direct evidence, an explicit provenance-backed descriptor relation, or abstention resolves the trace gap.
internal_semantic_integrity.history_policy: Intermediate v1 private audit preserved; v2 adds exact relation-ID registry validation.

descriptor_relation_readiness.relation_contract: IS_A permits narrower-to-broader inference only; SYNONYM requires exact owner-approved provenance; CO_HYPONYM is diagnostic and does not propagate evidence.
descriptor_relation_readiness.coarse_dimension_result: The 59 named descriptors contain 360 pairs sharing at least one support dimension, including 35 pairs between a registered middle category and another named descriptor. Zero semantic edges were inferred from these compatibility pairs.
descriptor_relation_readiness.c01_assertion_result: Of 632 C01 named occurrences, 152 have a direct descriptor trace and 480 remain unlicensed for strict assertion. Only 19/79 records would retain at least three strict assertions if the empty relation registry were enforced as a shadow mask.
descriptor_relation_readiness.relation_review_queue: C01 produced 535 occurrence-level review candidates covering 51 unique source-target-type combinations. They remain candidates only; frozen relation_evidence_ids contained zero occurrences.
descriptor_relation_readiness.selection_gate: MMR, weighted propagation and submodular selection were not run because there are no approved descriptor edges and no authority to choose lambda, decay or beta. OUT_SEPARATED and the default finalizer were unchanged.
descriptor_relation_readiness.next_admissible_step: Review exact candidate pairs against provenance, register only owner-approved directed edges, then rerun the boolean assertion audit before considering any relation-aware selector.
